# Adhan JS 4.4.3

Copyright Batoul Apps and contributors. The unmodified ESM bundle and source map
come from the [Adhan JS 4.4.3 npm archive](https://registry.npmjs.org/adhan/-/adhan-4.4.3.tgz).
The bundle extension is changed to `.mjs` so Node loads it as an ES module.
See the upstream [repository](https://github.com/batoulapps/adhan-js) and the
included MIT license.
